review_dataset_info: review the dataset_info dictionary containing COCO keypoint definitions, skeleton links, joint weights, and sigmas for pose estimation
summarize_keypoint_info: summarize the 17 COCO keypoints including nose, eyes, ears, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, and ankles with their colors and swap mappings
summarize_skeleton_info: summarize the 19 skeleton links defining the human pose graph structure for COCO dataset visualization
review_joint_weights: review the joint_weights array used to weight loss contributions per keypoint during pose estimation training
review_sigmas: review the sigmas array containing COCO keypoint tolerance values used for OKS (Object Keypoint Similarity) metric calculation
